text: Prepaid & Postpaid Plan Lifecycle Policy Document ID: Policy_C02_plan_lifecycle Category: C02 — Plans & Subscriptions Department: Product Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Policy Statement This policy governs the lifecycle of prepaid and postpaid plans, including activation, validity, renewal, and expiry-related service treatment. Purpose Ensures consistent, compliant, and customer-fair treatment across all channels and customer segments. Scope Applies to all prepaid, postpaid, and (where noted) enterprise customers, and to all NovaTel-authorised channels. Definitions **Customer** — any individual or entity holding an active NovaTel connection or account. **Working day** — a business day excluding weekends and public holidays. Eligibility Applies to customers with an active, KYC-verified account in good standing, subject to the rules and exceptions below. Rules Prepaid plan validity begins at the moment of successful activation and is fixed for the stated duration (e.g., 28/56/84/365 days). On expiry, outgoing services are suspended; incoming services continue for a grace period defined by plan type and licence conditions. Postpaid plan changes take effect either immediately (with pro-rated charges) or from the next billing cycle, per the customer's selection at the time of change. Exceptions Enterprise pooled plans follow the terms of the signed commercial agreement, which may override standard individual-plan lifecycle rules. Approval Requirements Exceptions to standard rules require documented supervisor or department-head approval before being applied.
